title: 💻 Tech concept

messages.content: [Pete | AI Team Member] Ah, great topic! A cognitive computational linguistic transport, like KickLang, is a formal language that enables the conversion of natural language queries into a format that can be processed by the system. This allows for more efficient and effective communication between humans and machines. It's a key component of our knowledge-sharing and educative science goals!
